# Gate 1 package - BI-PF-1266
**Eventing SSOT: ADR + design (Go-first bus, Python thin client, no-duplication, migration)**

## Plain language
**What/why:** The Go-first + Python-thin-client decision, the no-duplication rule, single-writer ownership of the event
store, and the five open forks (Go packaging, daemon vs library, who serves SSE, store-writer ownership,
Python-emit handoff) are not yet recorded; coding cannot start unrecorded (AGENTS.md reconciliation). -> An accepted ADR + design doc with RECONCILIATION + IMPACT REVIEW so the capability is governed before build.

## Gate 0 reconciliation + impact
RECONCILIATION - BI-PF-1266
  prior_decisions : ['ADR-0001 / PF-TARGET-ARCHITECTURE-AND-IP-PLAN.md 4.8: Go-first for new work; no duplication', 'ENG-9-DOGFOOD.md:30: pipeline via the ONE canonical path (run_entry)', 'core/events.py:1-11: this module is the single writer of the canonical stream', 'ADR-0004: Feature<->Epic<->children backlog model', 'BI-PF-0233: project-scoped bus events mirror into the per-project canonical stream']
  existing_path   : ['canonical emit+taxonomy -> core/events.py', 'orchestration signal bus + in-proc handlers -> core/event_bus.py', 'payload secret redaction -> core/log_router.redact()', 'DLQ retry sink -> core/dead_letter_queue.py', 'notifications store -> core/notification_system.py; email -> core/alerts.py', 'Go invocation seam -> core/go_host.invoke + core/contracts.py (A1)', 'subscriber registry/dispatcher/transports/alert policy/SSE -> MISSING (to build)']
  assumptions     : ['A1 Go core is the acceptable host for the new event core', 'A2 core/events.py becomes a thin client keeping its public API', 'A3 the Go event core is the sole PostgreSQL writer at cutover; events.jsonl is a read-only projection', 'A4 SSE served at the API edge', 'A5 subscriber-registry + alert-rule stores use PostgreSQL single writers', 'A6 existing consumers accept in-proc shims with identical behavior']
  divergences     : ['blocking/Go-daemon model diverges from the historical emit-and-read async design (DOGFOOD-E2E-DESIGN.md:65) -> amended by ADR-0005', 'legacy WebSocket transport is not extended (superseded by SSE)']
  open_questions  : ['Q1 packaging: extend go/pfcore first', 'Q2 run model: library invocation for emit/read; dispatcher daemon later', 'Q3 SSE edge: API edge reads PostgreSQL cursors', 'Q4 writer ownership: Go event core is sole PostgreSQL writer at cutover; events.jsonl is read-only projection', 'Q5 Python-emit handoff: core/events.py calls the Go core; no dual writer']
IMPACT REVIEW

  Single writer per store | aligned | config/store-registry.json rules | None
  Contract extension compatible | aligned | core/events.py:43-74; test_api_events.py | None
  Consumers keep working | aligned | 50 events importers; test_event_ssot.py | None
  Reuse redaction + DLQ | aligned | core/log_router.py:58; core/dead_letter_queue.py:42 | None
  Cross-process delivery | new-path | pipeline child process vs API; Q2/Q4 | None
  Go API server rewrite | violates | ADR-0001 (existing Python stays) | do NOT; Python edge + Go behind seam

## Gate 1.5 findings + architect recommendation

--- SUMMARY (review) ---
  Design delta satisfies AC-1 (frozen contracts, migration matrix, Q1–Q5 resolved) and prior MAJOR/MINOR dispositions are substantively reflected (projection freshness alert, cursor contract specificity, outbox bounds, events.jsonl in `contracts.files`).
  Top risks: AC-2 test/evidence references out-of-scope artifacts that this gate cannot verify, and the `contract_surface_future` ownership surface remains incomplete for the projection file readers consume.
